newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity Investments names Burkhead FMR vice chair.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity Investments names Burkhead FMR vice chair.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Monday J. Gary Burkhead has been named vice chairman of FMR Corp, Fidelity's parent company.

The company said Burkhead was also named president and chief executive officer of Fidelity Institutional Group, comprising Fidelity's institutional retirement, trust, financial intermediary, brokerage, and Canadian institutional businesses.
Fidelity chairman and chief executive officer Edward Johnson 3rd said the job was created the job for Burkhead.

The company also said Robert Pozen has been named president and chief executive officer of Fidelity Management & Research Co, the investment advisor to the Fidelity family of mutual funds. He will succeed Burkhead.
